title: DelegateResponse
description: Response to a delegation request. A valid request returns the run identifier immediately in the submitted state, without waiting for the child; an invalid request returns an error and creates no run.

oneOf.description: Accepted request: the run exists in the submitted state.

run_id.description: Identifier assigned by the broker to the new run.

state.description: State of the run at the moment of acceptance.

oneOf.description: Rejected request: a validation error that names each invalid field.
